name: mb-marketing
description: MB brand reference (colours, typography, logo, tone of voice, brand history), a conversational brand-vs-competitor comparison skill, a full social content toolkit (write, grade, and repurpose MB-branded posts for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and Meta), a WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility QA pass on the Canva creatives those skills draft, and a complete SEO and GEO toolkit (technical audits, ranking and AI-citation content writing, keyword and competitor analysis, backlink auditing). On-brand voice, curated hooks, and legal-marketing compliance guardrails built in throughout. Also ships an experimental (beta) Excel reporting builder that inventories a workbook's columns, confirms what the metrics mean before building, and reconciles every staged calculation to zero.
